description: This Java class defines a custom Freemarker template transform (RenderWrappedTextTransform) used in the OFBiz framework. It facilitates rendering wrapped text, particularly URLs or links, within templates by providing a custom Writer implementation that outputs a specified wrapped string if available.

classes.name: RenderWrappedTextTransform
classes.description: A Freemarker TemplateTransformModel that outputs a wrapped string during template rendering, primarily used for rendering URLs or links.

methods.name: getWriter
methods.description: Returns a Writer that writes the wrappedFTL string if it is not empty, otherwise logs info and skips writing.
